title: tooling(fleet-roster): hasLandingVerdict requires a bare `## 席位核对` heading, so the seat's live `## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · …` records are not read as verdicts while H69's marker reads them
body:
Filed by the `domain:skills#2` seat (`session_01LqKsGyMNFwwnbF5FTAqyPn`, seat post #19287) from the independent contract review on PR #26327 (comment 6427853793, ① (c) and ③ Boundary flags). A pre-existing recogniser mismatch noticed while reviewing H69; ⛔ not a claim.

**Origin:** `scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs` `hasLandingVerdict`: the 席位核对 arm tests `/^##[ \t]*席位核对[ \t]*$/m` — the heading line must end right after the characters — plus a line-initial `ACCEPT`. `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` (from #26327) `SEAT_RECORD_MARKER = /^\s*>?\s*## 席位核对/m` reads a prefix. The seat's live records on Tier H PRs (e.g. PR #26311 comment 6426788546) open `## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · domain:skills#2 · session … · time`, which the second recogniser matches and the first does not. Two recognisers now read one artefact differently.
**Reader who acts:** the lane that owns `scripts/pm/**` (tooling), with the pm-dispatch skill's record template (`SKILL.md` ①, `references/execution-duties.md` ~184) as the shape of truth.
**Suggested grade (triage grades):** p3 — report-only consumers today (the roster's landing-verdict read), but a silent disagreement between recognisers is how a later gate reads wrong.

**Who pays:** whoever reads `fleet-roster` for "which governed pulls carry a landing verdict": a PR whose seat record carries the inline ACCEPT heading is reported as having none.

**Measured:** PR #26311 comment 6426788546 line 1 `## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · …` → `hasLandingVerdict` false (heading arm fails on the ` — ACCEPT …` tail; the `**ACCEPT**` line-initial arm never reached), `SEAT_RECORD_MARKER` true. PR #26327 comment 6427897949 (bare `## 席位核对` then `**ACCEPT** · …`) → both true. `fleet-roster.mjs` self-test cases 589–591 cover only the bare heading.

**Wanted:** one spelling rule for the seat record's heading, stated once in the pm-dispatch skill (bare `## 席位核对` on its own line, verdict on the next line — the shape H69's live probe and the roster's self-test both accept), and `hasLandingVerdict` and `SEAT_RECORD_MARKER` share one exported recogniser (or `hasLandingVerdict` reads the prefix as H69 does), with a self-test case for the inline-ACCEPT spelling in both scripts.

**Card-specific acceptance:** the two recognisers answer the same on the three measured bodies (bare heading + ACCEPT, inline `— ACCEPT` heading, `## Contract review` PASS); `node scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs --self-test` and `node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test` green. If the skill text changes, the PR is Tier S (`.claude/**`). `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none`.
